demoData.privacyPolicy: We use the details you submit only to respond to your catering enquiry and coordinate your requested service. We do not sell enquiry information to third parties. You can ask us to correct or remove your enquiry details by contacting us.

enquiry.heading: Tell us about your celebration.

faq.question: What is the minimum order size?
faq.answer: Minimum guest count can vary by event type, location and menu. Add your own minimum in Admin > FAQ.

faq.question: Are transport charges extra?
faq.answer: Transport can vary by venue distance and event size. Confirm the applicable travel or transport charge during the enquiry.

faq.question: Do you provide plates and serving staff?
faq.answer: Yes, where offered by the business. Use Admin > Event Services to specify exactly what is included or available on request.

faq.question: Can I customize the menu?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the enquiry form to share dietary needs, regional dishes, theme preferences or special requests.

faq.question: How early should I book catering?
faq.answer: Booking lead time depends on the date, guest count and event type. Earlier enquiries are helpful for busy wedding and festival dates.
